title: Austin's Financial Future & Meeting Hurdles
summary:
*   The meeting faced an initial delay and could not officially begin due to absent members.
*   Attendees previewed proposed agenda items slated for the upcoming April 25 session.
*   A detailed financial forecast for the city was presented and discussed by officials.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
APRIL 17,1996
Mayor Pro Tern Garcia started the meeting, but did not call it to order for lack of a
quorum, Mayor Todd, Councilmembers Mitchell, Nofziger, Reynolds temporarily absent.
PREVIEW OF ITEMS FOR NEXT COUNCIL MEETING 1.
Review of Proposed Agenda Items from City Manager for April 25, 1996. 2.
Review of Proposed Agenda Items from Council for April 25, 1996. BRIEFINGS AND DISCUSSIONS
3.
FINANCIAL FORECAST
Presentation given by: Jesus Garza, Charles Curry, Jose Gonzales, Michael Abkowitz, Willie
Rhodes, Matt Kite, Paul Hoffman, Peter Rieck, Randy Goss, Maria Elena Garcia.
ADJOURNED at 4:00 p.m. on, Councilmember Reynolds' motion, Mayor Pro Tern Garcia's second,
6-0 vote, Councilmember Nofziger absent.
Approved on this the 25th day of April, 1996, on, Councilmember Shea's motion,
Councilmember Nofziger's second, 4-0 vote, Mayor Todd, Councilmembers Goodman and Reynolds
temporarily absent.
